roadmap.title: Stage 1 - The story, straight through
roadmap.text: Play the campaign in order: Gone Fishing, Chapters 1 to 4, the named missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission. That is all 12 story trophies, none of them missable, ending with the gold You Gotta Know When to Get Off.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 - Stranger strands before you outrun them
roadmap.text: The five named stranger chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are reported to have windows tied to story progress, so finish each strand's final mission as it develops instead of saving them for the endgame. Together with Bret's hunt and three more strands they also complete Strangers & Freaks' 8 strands.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 - Feats, partners and robberies while the world is fresh
roadmap.text: The one-off trophies: partner escapes (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), Combat Focus and the robbery feats (jewelry store, armored truck, one illegal operation per gang), the VCIA departure and the Rhino, and the playful hidden moments (Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom exit, bowling, melee drive-by). None of them needs a grind; take them as the opportunities appear.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 - The activity grind
roadmap.text: The tracked skill work: 42 Shooting Range gold medals at Griffin and Rodgers Ranch, 250 stunts, a Top Fun drone-race win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, one try at each of the 9 activity types, and the first 50 of the 80 Challenges.

roadmap.title: Stage 5 - Collectibles and the full map
roadmap.text: Sweep Leonida: 3 Collectible Card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, every meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude (the reported possibly-missable one - keep it current, do not leave it all to the end), and uncover the whole map for The Goodtime State.

roadmap.title: Stage 6 - Money, property, 100%, platinum
roadmap.text: Close it out: 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped, $250,000 of Marked Bills laundered, $100,000 spent in shops, every garage property bought and 10 vehicles registered on the Scooter Bros app. What is left of the 100% checklist (70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 18 card sets) completes A Long Road - and Vice Got a Price!, the platinum, pops on its own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum, and the last trophy that will pop. It unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly: work the roadmap in order - story first, missable stranger strands before you outrun them, then the activity and collectible grinds, and 100% completion last - and this closes the list.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Platinum structure and grade split - EGamers.io, 'GTA 6 Trophy List'.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops as the mission ends, so just start the game and play the first mission through. The campaign is linear, so story trophies cannot be missed on a normal playthrough.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 1. Keep playing the main missions after the opening and it pops at the chapter break; there is no side requirement and no way to skip past it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 2. It follows Paradise Lost in the campaign order, and pops when the chapter's final mission ends. The asterisks are part of the official name, exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 3. Play the main story through the third chapter; the trophy lands at the chapter break, after T**s Ass Drug Money and before the Chapter 4 trophy.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 4. The last of the chapter trophies before the finale: finish the fourth chapter's missions and it pops, leaving only the final-mission gold ahead of you in the story set.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: complete the final mission of the campaign. Some listings describe the campaign as five chapters with this trophy closing the last one; either way it pops at the end of the story, after Top Of The World, Ma, and it is the one story trophy worth a gold.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Campaign shape - Beebom and CULTR wording, as noted in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one sit inside the chapter structure, so it pops in passing as you play the campaign in order; no extra condition is attached to it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, one of the campaign's named set-piece missions. Play the story and it unlocks when the heist is done; a heist you finish is a heist that counts, whatever approach you took inside it.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. It arrives as part of the main campaign sequence, so keep following the story markers and it pops at the mission's end.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Headliners. A named campaign mission: reach it in the story order, finish it, and the trophy is yours. Nothing in the official description adds a score, time or stealth condition.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown. VCIA is the airport, and this named mission is part of the campaign; it pops when the mission completes as you work through the story.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, the last of the named-mission bronzes in the story set. Finish the mission during the campaign and it unlocks; together with the chapter trophies it completes the 12-trophy story set.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the game's own checklist - the long pole of the platinum. Published 100% checklists break the target into partial requirements rather than everything in the game: for example all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 70 of the 80 Challenges, and 15 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. Almost every other trophy feeds points into this one, so leave it for the final stage of the roadmap and mop up whatever categories are still short.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. 100% checklist breakdown - The Gamers Hub, 'GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist'.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps and stunt events scattered across Leonida all feed the one tracked counter, so the efficient way is steady progress: clear stunts as exploration takes you past them, keep a note of the ones you skip, and sweep the remainder in the mop-up stage rather than grinding all 250 in one sitting.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Stunt total as published in the official description; grind notes - Push Square, 'GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap'.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Listings of the official list count 9 activity types, and the trophy only asks for a first attempt at each - not a win, not a medal. Sample everything once as it unlocks on the map and save your effort for the activity trophies that demand gold medals and wins.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Activity type count - HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges - 42 golds in total, the count PlayStation tracks. Published range guides put them at two ranges, Griffin in north-west Vice City and Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range north-east of Port Gellhorn, six courses each with a gold medal per difficulty tier; talk to the clerk and buy the $5 waiver pass before the challenges are marked on your map. These same 42 golds sit on the 100% checklist, so every medal counts twice.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Range locations, course and medal structure, waiver pass - PowerPyx, 'GTA 6 All Shooting Range Gold Medal Challenges'; Push Square, 'GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap'.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Guides counting the locations put them at 14, and this trophy needs one win at each - the fuller set of drone trials behind them is a 100% requirement, not this trophy's. Take one win per location as you tour the map and move on.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Location count - HowToVideoGame trophy list; GTA-Zone, 'GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements'.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The wins have to come in 20 different races - repeating one easy race twenty times does not move the counter - so work through the race calendar across Leonida and bank one win in each event until you reach twenty.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, enter it and finish ahead of him. It is a single contest rather than a grind: one win over Cal earns the trophy, and fishing is also one of the activity types Master of None wants you to sample.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk up to an arcade cabinet, play one game through to its end - the trophy asks for a finished game, not a high score or a win - and it pops. One of the quickest bronzes on the list.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, closing out his stranger mission strand. Flagged as a missable risk: reporting on the stranger chains says their availability windows are tied to story progress, so finish Andy's strand promptly as it develops instead of leaving it until after the finale.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, closing out his stranger mission strand. Flagged as a missable risk for the same reason as the other stranger chains: their windows are reported to be tied to story progress, so keep Kenton's strand moving alongside the campaign rather than saving it for the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, closing out his stranger mission strand. Flagged as a missable risk: the stranger chains are reported to have windows linked to story progress, so finish Billy's missions as they appear and do not let the main story run too far ahead of them.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each strand is one stranger's chain of missions; the five named chains behind the hidden final-mission trophies - Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone - count toward the eight, and the rest come from other strangers met around the state. Because some chains have story-linked windows, work strands as they appear instead of stockpiling them for the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, closing out his stranger mission strand. Flagged as a missable risk: the stranger chains are reported to open and close with story progress, so complete Randy's strand while it is on offer.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, closing out his stranger mission strand. Flagged as a missable risk on the same reporting as the other four named chains: windows tied to story progress, so finish Tyrone's missions before pushing the campaign past them.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Stranger-chain windows tied to story progress - TechWiser, as summarised in the EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Treat the meditation spots as a collectible set and sweep them methodically, area by area, as you explore. This is the one trophy several guide outlets flag as possibly missable, so do not assume every spot stays available forever: keep the set current as you travel and make a final pass before the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Possibly-missable flag - GTABase and PowerPyx, as reported by EGamers.io and CryptoGames.gg trophy lists.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take up Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal it names. It is a single scripted hunt rather than a tally, so one successful hunt earns the trophy; it sits in the stranger set, so pick it up while you are working the other strands.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are collectibles found across Leonida and gathered into themed sets; finishing any three sets earns the trophy. Keep collecting afterwards if you are chasing 100%: a published checklist puts the completion target at 15 of 18 sets, far beyond this trophy's three.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Set total and 100% target - The Gamers Hub, 'GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist'.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations around the state; the game tracks the count, so build it up during ordinary travel and exploration, and if you fall short, sweep new neighbourhoods in the mop-up stage until the counter reaches 100.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's built-in skill feats, and published guides count 80 of them in total - so you can leave the 30 that suit you least and still earn this comfortably. Going further pays off later: the 100% checklist wants 70.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Challenge total - Push Square, 'GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap'; 100% target - The Gamers Hub checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level up to four stars while your partner is with you, then break the police line of sight and stay out of view until the stars drain away. The trophy is in the escape, not the firefight, so pick a spot with cover and an exit before you start.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Requirement read from the official description; wanted level is counted in stars (4).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain the three robberies inside one continuous wanted session: go straight from shop to shop with your partner present, because letting the Wanted Level drop to zero between robberies breaks the chain and the count starts again.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when the game registers it - getting in is the reliable way - and with several hundred models in traffic, dealerships and parking spots across Leonida, deliberately sampling vehicles you have not driven gets to 100 well before the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Vehicle variety - activity and vehicle databases summarised at GTA6Database (gta6database.com).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The whole job is setup: gather a group of at least five enemies in view - a gang spot or a crowded firefight - then trigger Combat Focus once and drop all five before the effect ends. If the group is too small or too spread out, reposition and try again rather than wasting the activation.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The official wording is a joke at the airport's expense: an unscheduled departure from VCIA means leaving by air without being scheduled to - in practice, take an aircraft from the airport and get airborne. The trophy is hidden, so expect it to pop as a surprise the first time you lift off from VCIA in a plane that is not yours.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhino is the series' name for its battle tank, so this hidden trophy is about the tank: get into a Rhino and put it to use. The description names no count and no place, so a single tank escapade is the natural reading - expect heat in both senses, and treat any more specific claim as unconfirmed.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The robbery only counts if nobody detects you, so go in quietly, keep it fast, and be gone before an alarm or a witness raises the alarm. A detected attempt is spent: leave, let things cool down, and make the next attempt a clean one.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Opening the vault is only half of each count - the escape has to succeed too, so plan the getaway before you start each robbery and let the Wanted Level clear to bank it. Five clean vault-and-escape runs earn the silver.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop an armored truck, get into its cash hold, take the money and then lose the heat: the escape is part of the requirement, so have a fast car or a place to hide ready before you make your move.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The state map fills in as you visit it, and this pops when every region has been uncovered. It comes naturally late in a completion run; in the mop-up stage, sweep any still-fogged corners of the map by road, boat and air until the state is fully revealed.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations, and the requirement is one operation per gang - variety, not volume. Keep a note of which gangs you have already hit so the last gang does not become a guessing game late in the run.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A quiet-moment trophy: the description names the place (Ocean Beach), the act (a cocktail) and the point of it (the view). Head to Ocean Beach and use the cocktail or drink interaction there, somewhere with the ocean in front of you.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass frontage - 'classic style' is the series' long-running joke about how every showroom visit ends. The description gives the act and the place type, so any vehicle showroom fits the reading.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the named bowling alley and bowl: 'follow-through' is bowling language for the arm's motion after the ball is released, so a played turn at that alley is the natural reading of a deliberately playful description. No score is named, so a completed game is the safe target.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The vaguest description on the list: it points at the game's two protagonists - the partnership - doing something together that lands with a crowd. No act, place or count is named, and the trophy is hidden, so the honest guide is that this reads as a one-off partner moment rather than a grind; anything more specific is unconfirmed until players pin it down.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Unconfirmed-detail convention - EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This tracker counts the choices you make through the game, and listings of the official list note that it counts to 500 - so it fills up through ordinary play as the story, strands and activities keep presenting decisions. There is nothing to grind and, on the description, nothing that punishes a 'wrong' choice: choose as you play and the counter does the rest.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Count of 500 - HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. A retry trophy by its wording: something that does not come off the first time and does the second. The description names no place, act or count, so treat it as a hidden moment that pops on a repeated attempt at whatever you just failed - and treat any more specific claim as unconfirmed.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Unconfirmed-detail convention - EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The title ('The Truth Is Out There') and the stunned reaction in the description point at witnessing something unexplained over Leonida - the series' traditional UFO flavour. No location or time is named in the official description, so any specific spot would be a guess: keep your eyes on the sky at night and expect a scripted strange encounter.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'. Unconfirmed-detail convention - EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike people down with melee attacks delivered from a moving vehicle - the ten-pin image is the joke: a line of targets knocked flat in one pass. The description names the act plainly, so use drive-by melee attacks until it pops.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Hidden/visible split - Insider Gaming, 'Complete GTA 6 Trophy List'; HowToVideoGame, 'GTA 6: Trophy and Achievement List'.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are robbery proceeds; pass them to your contacts to launder and the laundered total accumulates toward $250,000. It is a money counter, not a single score, so every robbery that yields Marked Bills feeds it - pair it with the robbery trophies and it fills steadily through the mid-game.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. A cumulative spending counter covering everything bought in shops - clothes, weapons, vehicle work and the rest. Ordinary upgrading through the story covers most of it; if you finish the campaign short, the endgame shopping spree for properties and garages closes the gap.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property the market offers. This is a money gate rather than a skill test, so it belongs in the last stage of the roadmap, once robbery and laundering income is steady enough to buy the whole set without pausing.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want to keep, register it through the Scooter Bros app; ten registrations earn the trophy. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good's 100 discovered vehicles - register the best of what you sample.
trophies.sources: Official trophy name, description and grade - PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles.
